en_title: Henry Cavill Is Open to Returning as Superman Once Again
cn_title: 亨利·卡维尔对再次回归饰演超人持开放态度
opus_summary: 亨利·卡维尔在接受采访时表示，他不会排除再次出演超人的可能，并称超人有许多精彩故事可以改编。DC Studios即将迎来新负责人Jeremy Latcham，他预计会调整DC的发展方向，但是否重启尚未确定。

paragraphs.en: Henry Cavill has stated that he's still open to the idea of playing Superman following all the shake-ups at DC Studios.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利·卡维尔表示，在DC Studios经历一系列人事变动后，他仍对饰演超人持开放态度。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with Inverse , Cavill was asked if he'd ever be interested in playing Superman again, and the interviewer suggested the Kingdom Come storyline as a possibility. Cavill noted he would never say never to the idea, and that there are a lot of "fantastic storylines" to adapt for Superman.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受Inverse采访时，卡维尔被问及是否有兴趣再次饰演超人，采访者提出《Kingdom Come》的故事线是一种可能性。卡维尔表示，他绝不会说这个想法没有可能，而且有许多「精彩的故事线」可以改编成超人的故事。

paragraphs.en: "Look, there's lots of fantastic storylines. There's always a lot of opportunity. As the pigeon sang to Fievel in An American Tail, 'never say never.' And I buy into that. I’ve had such a wonderful time playing Superman in the past. I would never say never now."
paragraphs.cn: 「你看，有很多精彩的故事线。机会总是很多。就像《美国鼠谭》里的鸽子对Fievel唱的那样：『永远不要说绝不。』我相信这一点。过去饰演超人的时光非常美好。现在我也绝不会说绝不。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, the timing of these comments could not come at a more interesting moment. If this happened a week ago, no one would've thought much of it. However, earlier this week, DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran were ousted from the company . They remain on board until December 1, when a new head, Jeremy Latcham, will take over. Latcham is expected to make changes to DC's direction, possibly resulting in a reboot, though that has yet to be firmly decided. His ultimate vision, however, is to focus on DC's mainstream characters in an effort to quickly assemble the Justice League on the big screen .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，这番言论发表的时机再有意思不过了。如果这发生在一周前，没有人会太在意。然而，本周早些时候，DC Studios负责人詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰被公司解职。他们将留任至12月1日，届时新负责人杰里米·拉契姆将接任。预计拉契姆将改变DC的发展方向，可能导致重启，不过此事尚未最终决定。不过，他的最终愿景是聚焦DC的主流角色，努力让正义联盟尽快在大银幕上集结。

paragraphs.en: Presumably, they'll wait until James Gunn's Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow, hits theaters in July to make a decision on whether they'll reboot or recast this DC universe. Cavill has famously been through a lot as Superman. His debut film, Man of Steel, was controversial thanks to the absurd casualties in his fight with General Zod. Batman v Superman also caused some friction with fans for a variety of reasons, one of which was that Superman was extremely brooding and miserable.
paragraphs.cn: 他们大概会等到詹姆斯·古恩执导的超人续集《Man of Tomorrow》于7月上映后，再决定是否重启这一DC宇宙或重新选角。众所周知，卡维尔饰演超人的经历可谓波折重重。他首次饰演超人的电影《超人：钢铁之躯》因为他与佐德将军的战斗中出现的大量伤亡而饱受争议。《蝙蝠侠大战超人：正义黎明》也因多种原因引起了一些粉丝的不满，其中之一是超人显得极为阴郁、痛苦。

paragraphs.en: After the catastrophic disaster that was Justice League, Cavill's role as Superman remained in question. There were rumors he would be replaced, while others indicated the powers that be simply weren't sure what to do with him. Eventually, Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson went above all of the WB execs and brought the actor back for a cameo in 2022's Black Adam, five years after Cavill's last appearance in the role. He was promised new Superman adventures ... but then, James Gunn took over DC just weeks later, and Cavill was essentially let go from the role .
paragraphs.cn: 在《正义联盟》遭遇灾难性失败后，卡维尔能否继续饰演超人仍是未知数。有传言称他将被替换，也有其他说法指出，掌权者只是不确定该如何安排他。最终，道恩·「巨石」·强森越过所有WB高管，让这位演员回归，在2022年的《黑亚当》中客串，距离卡维尔上一次饰演该角色已过去五年。有人向他承诺会有新的超人冒险故事……但仅仅几周后，詹姆斯·古恩接管了DC，卡维尔实际上被解除了这一角色。

paragraphs.en: The fact that Cavill is open to taking another crack at things after all of that is certainly interesting. Whether that opportunity ever comes remains to be seen, but it seems hard to imagine the new leadership reviving the Snyderverse.
paragraphs.cn: 经历了这一切之后，卡维尔仍愿意再尝试一次，这一点确实很有意思。这个机会是否会到来还有待观察，但似乎很难想象新的领导层会重振Snyderverse。
